gates.name: docs
gates.command: python3 scripts/text_check.py . && python3 scripts/issue_links.py . && python3 scripts/readme_status.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_readme_status.py && python3 -B scripts/agents_length.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_agents_length.py && python3 scripts/readme_figures.py --root . --check && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_readme_figures.py scripts/test_tool_facts.py && python3 scripts/risk_notice.py --root . && python3 scripts/release_notes.py --root . --check && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_risk_notice.py scripts/test_release_notes.py
gates.covers: links, anchors, invisible characters and linked issue references in every Markdown file, the README Status vocabulary of AGENTS.md (#268), every AGENTS.md within its line cap (the route map's 200 and 150), and the README tool tables, tool map and level table against a fresh generation from docs/tools.json, the level table and the registry (#407), the one risk notice in README.md, docs/install.md and site/index.html, and each released plugin's permissions and network list behind its release notes (#373)

gates.name: license
gates.command: python3 scripts/license_check.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_license_check.py
gates.covers: every LICENSE file, AGENTS.md License line and README licence link says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (#276)

gates.name: sleep
gates.command: python3 scripts/sleep_guard.py .
gates.covers: no test sleeps or bounds wall-clock time without a timing-independent note (Workbench #740, #1712)

gates.name: dry
gates.command: python3 scripts/dry_check.py --root . && python3 scripts/dry_cross.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_dry_cross.py
gates.covers: the DRY ratchet of dry-check.json: magic values, repeated blocks, identical files, repeated rules (#197), and dry_cross.py's Java and Swift values and one constant value named in two tools (#295)

gates.name: boundaries
gates.command: python3 scripts/boundaries.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_boundaries.py
gates.covers: the adapter boundaries of docs/architecture.md › Layer rules, over every package and plugin (#101), and ui-kit's Close on every full view and no failure reported by a toast alone (#259)

gates.name: registry
gates.command: python3 scripts/registry.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_registry.py
gates.covers: the registry of Supernote internals against registry/schema.json, its ratchet per level, and every file written from it, such as sn-adapter's descriptor.json (#294)

gates.name: packages
gates.command: cd packages && python3 ../scripts/npm_install.py && npm run validate
gates.covers: sn-adapter (both tiers, against the SDK mock in sn-adapter/testing), sync-core, ink-core, puzzle-core's generators and word lists, with the word pipeline's tests (#380, #381) and picture-search's search, measures, file store, image module, memory log, settings store, device search, thumbnails, picks, twins and «Insert best picture» tests, and the JVM tests of picture-search's and sn-adapter's Java (#254), picture-search's layer boundaries and its DRY ratchet (#288); ui-kit and the rest of picture-search run in the plugin gates the rules below map their folders to (#93, #125, #142)

gates.name: account-sync
gates.command: cd plugins/account-sync && python3 ../../scripts/npm_install.py && npm run validate
gates.covers: the Account Sync plugin, the ui-kit package's lint and tests, and the type check of the renders in packages/ui-kit/renders (#288)

gates.name: image-editing
gates.command: cd plugins/image-editing && python3 ../../scripts/npm_install.py && npm run validate
gates.covers: the Image Editing plugin and its JVM tests (#136)

gates.name: lasso-actions
gates.command: cd plugins/lasso-actions && python3 ../../scripts/npm_install.py && npm run validate
gates.covers: the Word Lookup plugin

gates.name: device-link
gates.command: cd plugins/device-link && python3 ../../scripts/npm_install.py && npm run validate
gates.covers: the Device Link plugin

gates.name: smart-pen
gates.command: cd plugins/smart-pen && python3 ../../scripts/npm_install.py && npm run validate
gates.covers: the Smart Pen plugin (#305): its module switches and settings file, the pen-up router, Real-Time Text's conversion over a fake tablet (#184) and Smart Shapes' recognition, hold and replace over a fake page (#253)

gates.name: ink-tools-probe
gates.command: cd plugins/ink-tools-probe && python3 ../../scripts/npm_install.py && npm run validate
gates.covers: the Ink Tools Probe plugin, its JVM tests and its type check of ui-kit (#257)

gates.name: handwriting-language
gates.command: cd apps/handwriting-language && node scripts/build.cjs --test && node scripts/build.cjs
gates.covers: the Handwriting Language app: its JVM tests and a signed, verified APK (#157, #160)

gates.name: ink-tools-helper
gates.command: cd apps/ink-tools-helper && node scripts/build.cjs --test && node scripts/build.cjs
gates.covers: the Ink Tools Helper app: its JVM tests of the PluginHost call encoding and a signed, verified APK (#215)

gates.name: inkctl
gates.command: cd cli/inkctl && make validate
gates.covers: the inkctl CLI and its contract tests

gates.name: note-editor
gates.command: cd apps/note-editor && (cd NoteFormat && swift test) && make check
gates.covers: the Note Editor: the NoteFormat reader (parsing, the RATTA_RLE decoder, the page composition, #261), then the app's build, lint, tests and invariants (#262)

gates.name: native
gates.command: python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_native_package.py
gates.covers: each plugin's light native build: one toolchain script for macOS and Linux, no .snplg left without its app.npk (#153)

gates.name: audit
gates.command: python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_npm_audit.py
gates.covers: the weekly npm audit's filter and audit-exceptions.json (#154)

gates.name: versions
gates.command: node scripts/plugin-version.cjs --workflows . && node scripts/plugin-version.cjs --icons . && node scripts/plugin-version.cjs --identity . && node --test scripts/plugin-version.test.cjs
gates.covers: every prerelease workflow's tag starts with <plugin>-v and every plugin's versionName follows its package.json version (#155, #302), every plugin's iconPath names a file (#248), and each plugin's names agree, its versionCode rises and the plugins share one react, react-native and sn-plugin-lib (#295), and no plugin reuses a version published under an earlier folder name (#410)

gates.name: case
gates.command: python3 scripts/case_check.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_case_check.py
gates.covers: no two tracked paths, or extensionless module names, differ only in case (#227); the Quick check runs it on every change

gates.name: wording
gates.command: python3 scripts/public_wording.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_public_wording.py
gates.covers: no tracked file outside its allowlist states the method used on vendor software, by the forbidden terms of scripts/public_wording.py (#408); the Quick check runs it on every change

gates.name: icons
gates.command: python3 scripts/icons.py --check && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_icons.py
gates.covers: every icon Ink Tools shows on the tablet is drawn from design/icons/icons.json in the native outline style (stroke, colour, caps, extent), its files are current, and no two read alike (#271)

gates.name: quick
gates.command: python3 scripts/workflow_paths.py --root . && cd scripts && python3 -B -m unittest test_quick_check test_workflow_paths
gates.covers: the Quick check's path selection: which subprojects a change type-checks (#180), and each validate workflow's paths equal to the gates.json rules of its gate (#301)

gates.name: device-build
gates.command: python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_device_build.py
gates.covers: scripts/device_build.py, the build of main for a device check, over a fake checkout and runner (#310)

gates.name: setup
gates.command: python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_gate_install.py scripts/test_cloud_config.py
gates.covers: each npm gate installs its subproject from its lockfile when node_modules is missing or older than the lockfile (#135, #222), and .github/cloud.json names every gate as a cloud gate but the Note Editor's (#301)

gates.name: design
gates.command: node --test design/covers/*.test.mjs
gates.covers: the InkHub cover template filler

gates.name: site
gates.command: bash scripts/validate-site.sh && python3 scripts/text_width_check.py site && python3 scripts/site_privacy.py --root . && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_site_privacy.py && python3 scripts/site_media.py check && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_site_media.py && python3 scripts/site_figures.py --root . --check && python3 -B -m unittest scripts/test_site_figures.py
gates.covers: the home page's tool cards, install guide, credits and licence against a fresh generation from docs/tools.json, docs/releases.json, docs/install.md and README.md (#437); the home page and privacy policy in site/: the Workbench site check, and both pages present with a privacy section for every plugin that declares INTERNET (#371); the tool pictures and videos the shot list of design/site-media names: sizes, budget, text alternatives and the page blocks (#414); no width cap on page text and a stable scrollbar gutter (Workbench #2124)
